results.question: Who are the best auto repair shops in Dalton, GA?

chatgpt.text:
For a Dalton homeowner who wants **reliable, local, not-too-fancy auto repair**, I’d start here:

1. **Tate Automotive — 203 S Selvidge St**  
   My top pick for general repairs. It shows up strongly across sources: CARFAX lists it at **5.0 with 143 verified reviews**, and local review aggregators also rate it highly. Good choice for diagnostics, maintenance, radiator/brake/suspension-type work. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair-Dalton-GA_c21157?utm_source=openai))

2. **Taylor’s Tire & Service — 1108 S Thornton Ave**  
   Best “family car needs fixing” option if tires, alignment, front-end work, or routine service are involved. Loc8NearMe shows **4.8 with 206 reviews**, with customers praising helpful staff and practical problem-solving. ([loc8nearme.com](https://www.loc8nearme.com/georgia/dalton/auto-repair/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Elite Auto Repair — 130 Richardson Dr**  
   Good independent-shop pick. It’s listed around **4.7–4.8 with 115+ reviews**, and it gets local word-of-mouth support. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/d/auto-repair/dalton-ga/?utm_source=openai))

4. **HANSON’S Tire & Auto — 1715 Cleveland Hwy**  
   Worth calling for tire/maintenance work; AutoRepairDirectories lists it at **4.9 with 253 reviews**. ([autorepairdirectories.com](https://www.autorepairdirectories.com/georgia/dalton?utm_source=openai))

I’d call two shops, describe the issue, ask for diagnostic fee, timeline, and whether they warranty parts/labor.

gemini.text:
If you’re looking for a reliable mechanic around Dalton, here are the local spots I always recommend to neighbors:

**1. Auto Tech of Dalton**
This is the go-to for tricky diagnostic work or major repairs. They’ve built a stellar reputation for honesty—they’ll give you a straight answer about what actually needs fixing now versus what can wait, and their quotes are always fair.

**2. Frank’s Auto Service**
For a classic, family-owned shop feel, Frank’s is top-tier. They handle general repairs, brakes, and maintenance with great attention to detail. The customer service is excellent, and they treat your car like it’s their own.

**3. Lingerfelt’s Auto Repair**
A long-standing local staple. People trust Lingerfelt’s because they get the job done right the first time, don't try to upsell you on unnecessary services, and turn cars around quickly.

**4. Brooker Tire & Auto**
If you need tires, alignments, suspension work, or routine oil changes, Brooker is hard to beat. They’re fast, reasonably priced, and super easy to work with.

Stick with any of these places, and you won't have to worry about getting taken for a ride.
